name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
benefit: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria like institutional landholders, income tax payers, retired pensioners > ₹10,000/month).
documents_required: Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_procedure: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in -> 'New Farmer Registration', or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / State Agriculture Office. Complete mandatory e-KYC via OTP or biometrics.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
benefit: Comprehensive risk insurance from pre-sowing to post-harvest against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rain, pests, cyclone). Uniform low premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial / Horticultural crops. Balance premium subsidized by Central & State Govts.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas (both loanee and non-loanee farmers).
documents_required: Land possession certificate / RoR / Tenancy agreement
application_procedure: Enroll via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), through Banks/PACS, or CSCs before the season cut-off date (usually July 31 for Kharif and Dec 31 for Rabi). In case of localized disaster, report loss within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App.
helpline: Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551 / Crop Insurance Helpline: 14447

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps & Grid Solarization)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefit: Component B: Up to 60% subsidy on standalone off-grid solar water pumps (3 HP to 10 HP) + 30% bank loan (farmer pays only 10%). Component C: Solarization of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps with option to sell surplus power back to DISCOM.
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, Water User Associations (WUAs), FPOs.
documents_required: Proof of current water source (borewell / pond / open well)
application_procedure: Register through respective State Renewable Energy Development Agencies (e.g., MEDA in Maharashtra, UPNEDA in UP, GUVNL in Gujarat, HAREDA in Haryana) or state agriculture portal.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term credit limit up to ₹3,00,000 at subsidized interest rate of 7% per annum; prompt repayment incentive of 3% brings effective net interest down to just 4% per annum. Collateral-free loan up to ₹1.60 lakh.
eligibility: All farmers (owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs, JLGs) and allied sector farmers (dairy, poultry, fisheries).
application_procedure: Submit one-page simplified KCC form at any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank branch; or apply online through bank portals.
helpline: NABARD Helpline / Contact local bank branch

name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Free soil testing card issued every 2-3 years indicating status of 12 soil parameters: Macronutrients (N, P, K), Secondary nutrients (S), Micronutrients (Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo), and Physical parameters (pH, EC, Organic Carbon), with customized fertilizer & amendment recommendations.
documents_required: Soil sample collected from GPS grid of farmer's field
application_procedure: Contact local Village Agriculture Assistant / KVK / Soil Testing Lab. View or download card anytime on soilhealth.dac.gov.in by entering state, district, and farmer name.

name: Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation / PMKSY)
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers and 45% subsidy for Other farmers on the capital cost of installing Drip Irrigation and Sprinkler systems (with additional top-up in many states up to 70-80%).
eligibility: All farmers with an assured water source on their land.
application_procedure: Apply online through State Horticulture / Agriculture portals (e.g. Mahadbt in Maharashtra, GGRC in Gujarat, TNHORT in Tamil Nadu, Upagriculture in UP).
helpline: District Horticulture Officer / State Agriculture Department

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY / Organic Farming)
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years: ₹31,000 directly for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, vermicompost), plus support for PGS-India organic certification, packaging, and marketing.
eligibility: Farmers forming clusters of 20-50 hectares (minimum 20-50 farmers per cluster).
application_procedure: Form a local organic farming group and submit cluster proposal to Regional Council / District Agriculture Officer or via Jaivik Kheti portal (jaivikkheti.in).

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefit: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking 1,300+ APMC mandis across 23 states/UTs, enabling transparent online bidding, real-time price discovery, assaying quality certification, and direct digital bank payment without middleman deductions.
eligibility: All farmers bringing agricultural produce to registered APMC mandis.
application_procedure: Register free on enam.gov.in or through e-NAM mobile app or at mandi entry gate registration kiosk.
